findings.title: Background reader thread in createMultiDeleteMultiReadMulti is never joined before asserting or exiting the test
findings.body: In `createMultiDeleteMultiReadMulti`, a background `Thread` is started at line 139 that continuously calls `managedRealm.admin().groups().groups(...)` until `deletedAll.get()` is true. After the main thread sets `deletedAll.set(true)` at line 155, it immediately asserts `assertThat(caughtExceptions, Matchers.empty())` without calling `thread.join()`. If an in-flight HTTP request on the reader thread fails with an exception after `deletedAll.set(true)` is executed, that exception will be added to `caughtExceptions` after the assertion has already passed, resulting in a false pass. Furthermore, the still-running thread can continue executing into subsequent tests in `GroupTest`, interfering with their realm state or admin event assertions.

findings.title: Overloaded getSubGroupsStream methods in GroupAdapter still dereference a potentially null modelSupplier.get()
findings.body: `getSubGroupsCount()` at line 274 was updated to check whether `modelSupplier.get()` returns `null` (which happens when a cached group was concurrently deleted from the database). However, the three overloaded `getSubGroupsStream` methods right above it (lines 256, 262, and 268) still call `modelSupplier.get().getSubGroupsStream(...)` directly without a null check. If a group is deleted concurrently while any of those `getSubGroupsStream` overloads is invoked on a cached `GroupAdapter`, `modelSupplier.get()` will return `null` and throw a `NullPointerException` instead of returning `Stream.empty()`.
